compliance.availabilityDisclaimer: Programme availability is subject to current qualification registration, Prestige Tutelage's applicable accreditation or approved delivery route, learner eligibility, workplace requirements and the relevant assessment and certification arrangements.
compliance.availabilityShort: Programme availability subject to current registration and enrolment conditions.
rules: No invented statistics, completion rates, learner numbers or client counts.
No named clients, testimonials or logos that are not supplied and approved.
No AI-generated people. Only the five genuine photographs already in the repository.
SAQA IDs, NQF levels and credits are quoted only where the repository holds a verified value.
Short courses are never described as accredited or credit-bearing.
B-BBEE posts claim Level 1 contributor status only, with no guarantee of client scorecard outcomes.
Prestige is never presented as a B-BBEE verification agency.

posts.subhead: Prestige delivers qualifications with formal assessment, moderation and quality assurance behind every result — and the learner administration that keeps the record clean.

Administration is not paperwork. It is part of the quality.

posts.headline: Production Technology, NQF 2 to NQF 4.
posts.subhead: Structured technical progression for production teams — from entry-level discipline on the line through to leading-hand responsibility.
points: Entry-level production staff building technical discipline

posts.footnote: Production Technology delivery and learner registration are subject to confirmation of the applicable current accreditation, registration and enrolment route.
posts.audience: Manufacturing operations managers, plant HR, production supervisors and skills development facilitators in industry
posts.visualDirection: No photograph. The navy field carries a three-row qualification ladder — each row names Production Technology, states its NQF level in blue at the right, and carries its SAQA ID beneath in muted type. The scoping note runs full width above the call-to-action bar.
posts.caption:
Production Technology at NQF 2, 3 and 4 — a structured route for the people who run the line.

NQF 2 (SAQA ID 58781) builds foundational technical and operational discipline for entry-level production staff. NQF 3 (SAQA ID 58785) consolidates technical competence on the line. NQF 4 (SAQA ID 58779) supports experienced staff moving toward technical and leading-hand responsibility.

Alongside these, we design customised technical interventions around a plant's own equipment, standards and problems — machine operation, first-line maintenance, 5S, root-cause analysis and quality awareness.

Production Technology delivery and learner registration are subject to confirmation of the applicable current accreditation, registration and enrolment route.

posts.headline: Two levels of HR qualification.
posts.subhead: A formal route from HR administration into generalist and advisory practice.

Officers progressing into generalist and advisory work
posts.footnote: Programme availability subject to current registration and enrolment conditions.

posts.visualDirection: Two-row qualification ladder on navy, each row carrying the role, its NQF level in blue, and the SAQA ID with credits beneath. Young-professional photograph as the top band.
posts.caption:
Two levels of HR qualification, and a clear route between them.

Human Resource Management Administrator sits at NQF Level 5, 120 credits (SAQA ID 121150) — a formal foundation for HR administrators and assistants building their grounding in human resource practice and people administration.

Human Resource Management Officer sits at NQF Level 6, 134 credits (SAQA ID 121151) — for HR officers and practitioners progressing into broader generalist and advisory responsibilities.

It is a practical way to build an HR pipeline inside the business rather than recruiting for it every time.

Programme availability is subject to current registration and enrolment conditions.

posts.headline: A structured route from no experience to a real qualification.
posts.headlineSquare: A real route to a real qualification.
posts.subhead: A learnership combines classroom learning with real workplace experience under a formal agreement between the learner, the employer and the training provider.
points: Classroom learning with structured workplace exposure
A formal learning agreement, not an informal placement
Learner support that keeps people engaged and progressing
A registered qualification at the end of the route
squarePoints: A registered qualification at the end
posts.footnote: Learner eligibility, programme availability and enrolment conditions apply.
posts.audience: Employers running youth programmes, CSI leads, community organisations and unemployed young people
posts.visualDirection: Graduate-celebrating photograph as the top band, green accent. The points explain what a learnership structurally is: four on the vertical, three on the square. No claim about employment outcomes appears anywhere on the poster.
posts.caption:
What a learnership actually is, in plain terms.

It is a structured, work-based route to a registered qualification. Classroom learning is combined with real workplace experience, under a formal agreement between the learner, the employer and the training provider.

An 18.2 learnership creates that structure for unemployed learners — proper learning, proper workplace exposure, and human support that keeps people engaged and progressing rather than dropping out halfway.

For employers, Prestige carries the load: learner sourcing, screening, onboarding, learning agreements, induction, delivery, workplace coordination, attendance, assessments, monitoring and reporting.

Learner eligibility, programme availability and enrolment conditions apply.

prestigetutelage.co.za

videoScenes.text: Structure, support and a route that finishes.

posts.visualDirection: Graduates-group photograph as the top band, blue accent. The headline states Level 1 B-BBEE plainly and four advisory services follow. The scope disclaimer is given real space above the call-to-action bar rather than being hidden as fine print.
posts.caption:
Prestige Tutelage is a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor.

Procurement from Prestige supports clients' own scorecards, and our programmes can support the skills development element of B-BBEE planning.

Beyond delivery, we help structure the work: skills gap analysis, training needs analysis, consulting on pathways, evidence and implementation, and the clean learner data and reporting that skills planning cycles depend on.

To be clear about scope — Prestige is a training provider and skills development consultancy, not a B-BBEE verification agency. Learnerships may contribute to an organisation's broader skills-development and transformation objectives, subject to applicable legislation, codes and programme requirements.

posts.headline: One partner, from the first gap analysis to the final report.
posts.subhead: One partner across analysis, delivery, learner administration, assessment and reporting — instead of a different provider for every piece of the work.
points: Understand — objectives, operations and constraints
Diagnose — skills gap and training needs analysis
Design — the right mix of interventions
Deliver — facilitation, logistics and administration
Measure — progress, completion and application
posts.audience: HR directors, L&D managers, operations managers and executives
posts.visualDirection: The only numbered layout in the campaign. Steps run 01 to 05 in blue on a strict vertical rhythm — the five verbs alone on the square, each with its explanation on the vertical. Graduates-together photograph as the top band.
posts.caption:
Five steps, one accountable partner.

Understand — your objectives, operations, people and constraints.
Diagnose — skills gap and training needs analysis grounded in the actual work.
Design — the right mix of qualifications, learnerships, short courses and workplace learning.
Deliver — facilitation, logistics and learner administration handled end to end.
Measure — progress, completion and workplace application reported clearly.

That means one partner across accredited programmes, learnerships, short courses, workplace training, assessment and learner administration, instead of a different provider for every piece.

prestigetutelage.co.za
